newsitem.title: UK: EMI up after press report of merger talks.
newsitem.headline: EMI up after press report of merger talks.

text.p: Shares in British music publisher EMI Group Plc moved ahead sharply in pre-market trading after press reports it had been in merger talks with Seagram Co Ltd, the Canadian drinks and entertainment group, dealers said.
EMI shares were up 38 pence at 1210p by 0721 GMT on volume of 150,000.
The Financial Times newspaper said EMI had broken off merger discussions with Seagram.
Neither company had previously made any mention of being in merger talks.
The FT said EMI has long been regarded as a takeover target and that Seagram was seen as the likeliest bidder.
The Financial Times said the two companies may have started talks before last Christmas.
Bid speculation for EMI intensified last summer when the group demerged from its former parent Thorn EMI which split its music and rental businesses.
EMI was not immediately available for comment.
